module.purpose: Provides selector factory functions and types for react-redux connect, creating memoized selectors that derive merged props only when state or ownProps change.
module.summary: This module defines TypeScript types for selector factories and implements two factory functions. pureFinalPropsSelectorFactory builds a closure-based memoized selector that tracks prior state and ownProps, using equality functions to decide whether to recompute stateProps, dispatchProps, or mergedProps. finalPropsSelectorFactory is the default export: it initializes the mapStateToProps, mapDispatchToProps, and mergeProps subselectors (via injected init functions), optionally verifies them in non-production environments, and returns the pure selector. The design enables connect's shouldComponentUpdate to bail out of re-renders when final props are unchanged.
module.businessContext: Core part of react-redux binding. Ensures connected components re-render only on relevant changes, preserving UI performance. Failure causes needless re-renders or stale props.
functions: pureFinalPropsSelectorFactory (~L67-158): Builds memoized selector managing prop derivation
finalPropsSelectorFactory (~L206-242): Default factory initializing subselectors and returning pure selector

env: Reads process.env.NODE_ENV to conditionally invoke verifySubselectors

units.name: handleFirstCall
units.source:
function handleFirstCall(firstState: State, firstOwnProps: TOwnProps) {
    state = firstState
    ownProps = firstOwnProps
    stateProps = mapStateToProps(state, ownProps)
    dispatchProps = mapDispatchToProps(dispatch, ownProps)
    mergedProps = mergeProps(stateProps, dispatchProps, ownProps)
    hasRunAtLeastOnce = true
    return mergedProps
  }

units.name: finalPropsSelectorFactory
units.source:
export default function finalPropsSelectorFactory<
  TStateProps,
  TOwnProps,
  TDispatchProps,
  TMergedProps,
  State,
>(
  dispatch: Dispatch<Action<string>>,
  {
    initMapStateToProps,
    initMapDispatchToProps,
    initMergeProps,
    ...options
  }: SelectorFactoryOptions<
    TStateProps,
    TOwnProps,
    TDispatchProps,
    TMergedProps,
    State
  >,
) {
  const mapStateToProps = initMapStateToProps(dispatch, options)
  const mapDispatchToProps = initMapDispatchToProps(dispatch, options)
  const mergeProps = initMergeProps(dispatch, options)

  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
    verifySubselectors(mapStateToProps, mapDispatchToProps, mergeProps)
  }

  return pureFinalPropsSelectorFactory<
    TStateProps,
    TOwnProps,
    TDispatchProps,
    TMergedProps,
    State
  >(mapStateToProps, mapDispatchToProps, mergeProps, dispatch, options)
}
